_meta.purpose: The class-word map, the spelled-out forms, and the policy for the trailing token of a physical name.
_meta.shape: GovernedDictionary(class_words=...) takes a plain abbrev -> full mapping, which is the "abbreviations" object here. "full_words" and "trailing_token_policy" are extra material this constructor has nowhere to put; see the open questions in README.md.

notes: A physical name is expected to end in a class word, written either as the abbreviation (CUST_ACCT_OPEN_DT) or spelled out (Customer Account Open Date). Both are accepted; only the trailing token is inspected.

default_class_word is what to_physical_name appends when the logical name ends in something that is not a class word and the policy allows appending. VAL/Value is the fixture's choice because it says least about the column; the value is data, not a constant, and a caller with a different house rule should be able to change it.
exempt_when_whole_name_is_class_word keeps a single-token name such as ID or STS from being rewritten to ID_VAL.

NamingPolicy in the contract carries require_trailing_class_word and append_class_word_when_missing but has no field for which class word to append, and GovernedDictionary has no constructor argument for this object. Reported as an open question.
